artBrief: **Cute chibi.** A friendly owl settles into a book-lined alcove with slippers and a little reserved-looking cushion, but no text on the cushion.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Cute chibi. A friendly owl settles into a book-lined alcove with slippers and a little reserved-looking cushion, but no text on the cushion. Keep the companion an OWL, as specified, with a round face and clear beak. Owl nestled into a book-lined alcove, soft slippers and a welcoming cushion, no lettering; warm cream and plum.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
